name: DIOR: Object Detection in Optical Remote Sensing Images
description: DIOR is a large-scale benchmark dataset for optical remote sensing image object detection, developed by Northwestern Polytechnical University. It contains 23,463 high-resolution aerial and satellite images (800x800 pixels) with 192,472 instance bounding-box annotations across 20 common object classes, spanning diverse sensors, seasons, weather conditions, and spatial resolutions from 0.5m to 30m.
